g.text: Common Session Compaction and Overflow Recovery
[stale ERROR or LENGTH overflow is recoverable]
Assistant with stop reason and Usage
[ERROR or LENGTH overflow and no prior recovery]
remove failed Assistant from retry context
summarize history and optional turn prefix
[STOP succeeds but Usage is already over context window]
return original successful answer; no replay
[valid Usage or fallback estimate exceeds threshold]
keepRecentTokens=20000. Disabled means no auto compaction.
Safe cut points are User or Assistant; retain an oversized last Assistant.
Update previous summaries and inherit sorted Read paths.
Summary calls use no tools, no cache, and a fresh routing ID.
History and split-turn max outputs are 80% and 50% of reserve.
Blank summaries, tool calls, failures, and aborts never replace context.
